<!-- Azeroth Chronicles: durable handoff so a new chat can resume without a transcript. Use an existing issue where possible. -->
## Objective and authority
- Owner-approved request / linked issue:
- Approved boundaries and canon / non-goals:
- Implementation authorized? (yes / documentation-only / paused):

## Remote checkpoint
- Base `main` SHA:
- Work branch and latest committed head SHA:
- Dependencies and generated/source assets:

## Evidence and remaining work
- DONE (committed and recoverable):
- IN PROGRESS or BLOCKED:
- Checks at exact SHA (PASS / FAIL / PENDING / NOT RUN, URLs):
- Known risks, save compatibility, and artifact/rollback links:
- **Next safe action a new chat can perform without this chat transcript:**

## Release gate
- [ ] Exact integrated candidate independently verified
- [ ] Owner explicitly authorized this specific merge/deployment

**Default: NO MERGE / NO DEPLOY.** A draft PR or partial test pass is not approval to publish. See [recovery desk #297](https://github.com/joedoragon-glitch/azeroth-chronicles-prototype/issues/297) and `docs/OWNER_GATED_DEVELOPMENT.md`.
